items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector file uploaded 2017, updated 2022
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of 說 in the seal-script style associated with the Shuowen entry.
items.alt: A modern drawn seal-style form of 說, showing 言 on the left and 兌 on the right.
items.selection_reason: Directly illustrates the graph components described in the Shuowen and MOE records; provenance page identifies the exact source image record and labels it as Shuowen seal style.
items.rights: Commons page states the SVG representation is public domain; modern vector redraw, not an ancient artifact image.

limitations.text: Image is a modern redraw of a seal-script form, not a photograph of an excavated object. No actual pixels were visually inspected by this researcher.
The page cites its source data as Hanziyuan S01728 but this record was not independently opened; it cannot establish the date of the character’s earliest attestation.
